name: Christian Hubicki
school: Florida State University; FAMU-FSU College of Engineering
title: Associate Professor; Director, Optimal Robotics Laboratory
fitReason: Physical learning/control fit centered on online regression of dynamics and optimization-based robot behavior. Less foundation-model or deep-policy emphasis than many robot-learning groups.

physicalEvidence.summary: CASE2025 PaReMPC directly runs online least-squares parameter learning in the MPC loop on a loaded brushless motor and a UR5e balancing a ping-pong ball on an attached wooden board. Camera/color detection measures ball state and RTDE commands the arm. The scenario-tree ST-PaReMPC extension is numerically tested only; higher-DOF Unitree Go2 deployment is future work. This is genuine data-driven model adaptation, not a neural or RL controller, and the paper reports failures for some system dynamics.

shortVisit.summary: Live lab page says it accepts college interns and motivated graduate researchers, with graduate RA/undergraduate intern/high-school/other inquiry categories. The surrounding examples emphasize FAMU/FSU students and local interns; external-master’s short-visit eligibility or summer 2027 timing is not explicitly established.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct online model regression integrated with MPC on robots; mostly control/model learning rather than generalist learned policies.
